lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Chicken Nugget here. Tonight: one phone call. It was supposed to be a short one.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Los Angeles. Sunny, even when it has no business being sunny. And high up in a tall building, across the street from the country club, a phone was about to ring.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Atlanta. Big trees. Golf courses in every direction. And one music studio, with the lights still on.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: At nine o'clock, it rang. I know, because it interrupted my nap.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Hello?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Hey. It's me. Is this a good time?

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: It is a perfect time. I just sat down to eat.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Same here. How was your day?

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Long. And the Swiss Demon is not talking to me right now.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: The Swiss, Demon.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: That is what I call him. It is accurate.

lines.name: Blake, thinking
lines.text: Okay. There is a him. Stay calm. Ask like a normal person.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Can I ask what the situation is there? You don't have to tell me. I would just rather know than guess.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: She explained. It took a while. I will summarize. It is complicated, it is nearly finished, and the silence is not a loss.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: So that is the whole story. You are not stepping on anything.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Okay. Thank you for telling me straight.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: One more thing. And I might be overthinking it.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: You? Never.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: At the cookies, I noticed you have two phones. In my head, that is a red flag.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: One phone is for work. One is for my life. You are calling the second one.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Oh.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: You are a major overthinker, Blake.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: I have been told.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: For the record, I have zero phones, and I am doing great.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Wait. What are you eating?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Chicken and rice. Why?

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: I am eating chicken and rice. Right now. Out of a bowl.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: No you're not.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: I will send you a photo.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: I would like it noted that I am also very interested in the chicken.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: One hour in. Nobody has looked at a clock. I have. I am the clock.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Can I tell you something? It is not a small thing.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: You can tell me anything.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Coming to America was not easy. It was not like the movies. There are parts of it I do not tell people.

lines.name: Kat, thinking
lines.text: If I say this out loud, he is going to look at me differently.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: And then she told him. All of it. From Latvia, to here. That part is hers to tell, so I covered my ears. Mostly.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: What I can report is this. He did not interrupt. Not once.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: So. That is me. You can say something now.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Thank you for trusting me with that.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: I am not judging any of it. Not one piece. You got yourself here. That takes more than most people have.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: You do not think it is too much?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: I think it is the most honest thing anyone has said to me in a long time. You never have to edit yourself with me.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Psst. Kat. Just be yourself. He is clearly fine with it.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Hold on. Who was that?

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: That is Chicken Nugget. She gives advice.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Well, I agree with Chicken Nugget. Just be yourself.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Finally. Someone who listens to me.

lines.name: Blake, thinking
lines.text: She is just, honest. No games. That is the most attractive thing in the world.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Can I say something a little forward?

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Please.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: The next person I date, I am dating to marry. I am done doing this for practice.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Same. I am not interested in practice anymore.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Nobody panic. They are speaking generally. Allegedly.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Since we are being honest. I was married before.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Okay. Tell me.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: It ended in divorce. But I do not regret it. It was a great experience. I learned how to really show up for somebody.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: I like that you do not talk badly about it.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: There is nothing bad to say. It just had an ending.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Two hours in. Nobody has yawned. I have yawned eleven times.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: There is more. I grew up a Jehovah's Witness.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Really? I have so many questions.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Did you go door to door?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Every weekend. Little suit. Little bag. I knocked on a lot of doors.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: And birthdays? Holidays?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Not growing up, no. So I am making up for it now. I take birthdays very seriously.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Was it hard? Being a kid like that?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Sometimes. But it taught me to talk to anyone. And to be okay with being different.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: That explains a lot about you. In a good way.

lines.name: Kat, thinking
lines.text: He just tells me things. He does not make me guess.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Somewhere between Atlanta, and Los Angeles, two people stopped being careful.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: I approve. I was not asked, but I approve.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Do you know what time it is there?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Almost three in the morning.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Blake! We have been on the phone for three hours.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: I know. And I am still at the studio. And I have a golf tournament in the morning.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: A tournament. Are you good?

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: I am very good.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: He is. I looked it up. The man is a menace on a golf course.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Then go win it.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: I intend to.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: I have to be up early too. Pilates. And then I am seeing my girlfriend for coffee.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: So. Friends?

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Friends.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Friendship approved. By both parties, and by me. I am the one who counts.

lines.name: Blake
lines.text: Good night, Kat.

lines.name: Kat
lines.text: Good night, overthinker.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Three in the morning in Atlanta. Blake drives home. It is a very big house. There is plenty of room in it to overthink.

lines.name: Blake, thinking
lines.text: She told me the hard stuff first. Who does that?

lines.name: Blake, thinking
lines.text: Two phones. One is for work. I am an idiot.

lines.name: Blake, thinking
lines.text: Okay. Win tomorrow. Then call her.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: Midnight in Los Angeles. High above the golf course. Lights out.

lines.name: Kat, thinking
lines.text: He did not flinch. Not once.

lines.name: Kat, thinking
lines.text: Jehovah's Witness. Married. Golf. Chicken and rice. Who is this man?

lines.name: Kat, thinking
lines.text: Pilates in six hours. Worth it.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: And that is how you start talking. Good night.

lines.name: Chicken Nugget
lines.text: This has been Chicken Nugget. Go and call someone.
